thread:
ellen: Quick heads-up — release cutoff in ~48h (Friday 18:00 UTC). Can we do a green-sweep tonight and lock versions? Any outstanding changelog items? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

shiv: I can run flaky test triage after lunch. Noted a recurring failure in CI: `tests/test_cache_eviction.py::test_eviction_on_memory_pressure` — reproduces locally sometimes.

marco: I pushed a tiny version-bump PR (merge request #489) for the sampler component, needs changelog line. cc @ellen @priya

priya: Adding changelog entry now. Question: should we fold docs-only PRs into this cut or leave for next?

ellen: Docs-only can slip unless it affects public API. Prioritize anything that changes runtime behavior or model configs.

qa-bot: buildkite/job/green-sweep-1752 started by @ellen — running 42 pipelines. Current status: 6 queued, 36 running.

shiv: For the flaky eviction test I'm trying a local stress run: `pytest -k eviction -n auto --maxfail=1` — if it flakes I have a patch to add a tiny sleep in the fixture. Will post results in ~2h.

marco: Branch coordination: main -> release/v2.5 merge planned at 17:00 UTC tomorrow. Please tag any hotfix PRs with `release/v2.5` label so they get cherry-picked.

priya: Changelog update pushed to #489, added bullet "Sampler: bump default temp to 0.9; see notes". Also added migration note.

ellen: Awesome. Can folks confirm they have CI green for their PRs? If not, leave a quick status.

shiv: My PR has one flaky failure (the eviction one). I disabled the specific flaky assertion locally and re-ran — passing 10/10. Will run the extended suite on a CI retry.

marco: My PR passed unit tests but failing one integration job related to model-serve smoke test — looks like infra flake (`ConnectionTimeout` to local docker image). Retrying.

qa-bot: buildkite/job/green-sweep-1752 update: 42/42 finished, 39 passed, 3 failed — investigating failures: 2 infra flakes, 1 deterministic test failure (cache eviction).

ellen: Ok, plan: (1) Marco & Shiv — prioritize fixing the infra flakes + eviction test today. (2) I'll do a changelog sweep and freeze the changelog at 15:00 UTC tomorrow. (3) If fixes aren't in by 16:00 UTC we may opt for a targeted revert/patch during the merge window.

shiv: Working on a repro branch `wip/eviction-flake-fix`, will open PR with test improvement + retry logic.

marco: Infra team notified for docker connect flakiness — pinged @infra on Slack.

deploy-bot: Reminder: release cutoff in 48 hours. Scheduled deploy window: Friday 19:00-20:00 UTC. If emergency, use `#oncall` to escalate.

priya: Quick note: Forgot to increment the package version in `pyproject.toml` for sampler — I'll do that now and push.

ellen: Thanks. Last ask: if your PR is merging into release branch, please include a one-line changelog in the PR body and add `changelog/required` label. I'll sweep labels at 15:00 UTC tomorrow and lock the branch. :lock:

shiv: Got it. I'll re-run full CI after I push the fix and update here with the new buildkite link.

marco: Re-run succeeded after infra retry, my integration job passed. I'll rebase and prep for merge.

qa-bot: buildkite/job/green-sweep-1752 final: 42/42 finished, 41 passed, 1 failed (tests/test_cache_eviction.py::test_eviction_on_memory_pressure).

ellen: Thanks for the quick work. Shiv — if the eviction test still fails after your fix, open a hotfix PR and tag `release/v2.5-hotfix`. We'll decide at cutoff.

shiv: Will do. Posting PR shortly.

marco: Everyone doing final self-checks: verify version bump, changelog, and CI green. I'll start the merge plan doc once we hit 40/42 green.

ellen: Closing loop: follow-up in morning for final green-sweep. If anything blocks, drop notes here. :white_check_mark:
